inputs.goal: port the admin app from Flask to FastAPI in verifiable slices

slices.description: Port Flask routes to FastAPI route definitions
Convert Flask views and response handling to FastAPI format
Migrate Flask templates to FastAPI template rendering or HTMX/JavaScript frontend if needed
Update request handling for FastAPI (query params, headers, etc.)
Implement FastAPI dependency injection to replace Flask context
Convert Flask blueprints to FastAPI router modules
Migrate database access logic (SQLAlchemy or other ORMs) if needed
Update testing suite from Flask test clients to FastAPI asynchronous test clients
Verify all endpoints are working in the new FastAPI application

port-slice.intake.summary: The goal is to port the admin app from Flask to FastAPI in verifiable slices. Current focus is on completing slice #1: Porting Flask routes to FastAPI route definitions.

content: Ensure all imported route modules are explicitly converted to FastAPI route definitions.
Verify each route's URL pattern is properly translated from Flask-style to FastAPI-style.
Check that HTTP method annotations (@app.route vs @router.get/post/etc.) are correctly mapped.
